_comment: Official SDU catalogue data (T0.6, US16): every 2026-2027 bachelor, master and PhD program from the fee orders and program pages on sdu.edu.kz, collected 2026-09-23 (12 programs) and 2026-10-08 (full list), pending admissions office review. Fees are per ECTS credit from the 2026-2027 fee orders. null = not published. title_ru / title_kk are the official Russian and Kazakh page titles. documents_from: the program uses the official document list of the named program (one list per degree level and applicant type on the admission pages). Open questions for the office: catalogue_review.md.
